page_title: ATM 4-3 SEV | Atletico Madrid v Sevilla 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short.
90+5' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.

90+4' 4 - 3 Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) meets a perfect cross from Samuel Lino deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the back of the net via the crossbar. The score is 4:3.
90+3' An attempted cross from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
90+2' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla) replacing Dodi Lukebakio.
90+2' The attendance is 60065.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. Marcao (Sevilla) comes on in place of Isaac Romero.
90+1' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
88' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
86' Atl. Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.
80' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Lucien Agoume and he is replaced by Gonzalo Montiel (Sevilla).
79' 3 - 3 Goal! Koke plays a short, square pass into the path of Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid), who bends a shot straight into the bottom left corner to make it 3:3. Fabulous goal!
79' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Clement Lenglet trots off the pitch and is replaced by Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid).
78' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Alvaro Fernandez is prepared to thwart his effort.
76' The whistle blows and Saul Niguez (Sevilla) is booked for an infringement.
75' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Giuliano Simeone will be replaced by Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Julian Alvarez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas had an easy-decision to make.
67' Alvaro Fernandez (Sevilla) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.

66' What a save from Alvaro Fernandez! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
63' Peque comes off the pitch to be replaced by Saul Niguez (Sevilla).
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Koke (Atl. Madrid) for Rodrigo de Paul.
63' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) replaces Conor Gallagher.

62' 2 - 3 Goal! Pablo Barrios finds Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the bottom right corner. Fantasy football! 2:3.

57' 1 - 3 It's a goal! Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) scores with a brilliant shot into the top right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Kike Salas. The score is now 1:3.

54' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Alvaro Fernandez pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner.
51' Peque (Sevilla) makes a strong challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
50' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
49' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
48' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

45+5' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Sevilla force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45+2' 4 additional min. will be played.
45+1' The goal by Atl. Madrid won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
45+1' Wait! Referee Javier Alberola Rojas has indicated he is going to review the Atl. Madrid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
45' Rodrigo de Paul provides Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
42' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
39' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

33' 1 - 2 Goal! Kike Salas puts Isaac Romero (Sevilla) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the right side of the goal. 1:2.
27' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
20' Sevilla are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla).
13' 1 - 1 Goal! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is teed up on the edge of the box by Nemanja Gudelj, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 1:1.
13' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) takes a short corner kick.
12' Peque (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Sevilla will have a corner.

10' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a magnificent shot into the top left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Alvaro Fernandez, so the score changes to 1:0.
10' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

9' Great save! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Alvaro Fernandez.
7' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Javier Alberola Rojas had a clear view and blows his whistle.
6' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the top of the crossbar.
6' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
5' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Atl. Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atl. Madrid will have the kick-off.
Javier Alberola Rojas got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
